moves.name: Forward Air
moves.notes: Bomb leaves his hands on 14, exploding automatically on 44 or upon touching ground. Autocancels on frame 42 onward. Advantage assumes landing on the same frame as bomb.

moves.name: Back Air
moves.notes: Landing hit on frame 1. Autocancels on frame 1-9 and 38 onward. The turtle's name is Augustus Philippe.

moves.name: Down Air
moves.notes: landing hit on frame 1. Autocancels on frame 1-5 and 50 onward

moves.name: Neutral B (Chef)
moves.notes: Projectile and melee attack generate on same frame. Generates new sausage every 32 frames

moves.name: Side B (Judge)
moves.notes:
Judge 1: Deals 12.0 recoil and no knockback.
Judge 3: Deals bonus shield damage.
Judge 5: Hits on frame 16/19/22/25.
Judge 7: Spawns three food items.
Judge 8: Freezes the opponent.

moves.name: Up B (Fire)
moves.notes: Invulnerable frame 5-13 Takes 7 frames to exit parachute by pressing down and avoiding landing lag. Can cancel directly with attacks as well. Opens parachute on frame 37.

moves.name: Down B (Oil Panic)
moves.notes: Begins absorbing/reflecting on frame 6. Takes 13 frames to put away bucket after extended usage. Has a 2x Damage Multiplier per unit. Maximum Damage of 16% per unit, this is also the minimum damage output. If an attack deals more than 10% it fills 2 Units, 20% for 3. Takes 6F to turn around.

moves.name: Oil Panic, Overload
moves.notes: Successful absorbs incur a 24 frame animation that is completely invulnerable.

moves.name: Pummel
moves.notes: Total frames includes 13 frames of hitlag.
